entries.title: Webhook signature verification timeout
entries.description: Fixed race condition in webhook signing verification that could cause occasional validation failures on high-throughput systems.

entries.title: Intelligence Report exports
entries.description: Added ability to export Intelligence Reports in CSV, JSON, and PDF formats with configurable date ranges and metrics.

entries.title: Improved Finault Score calculation
entries.description: Updated scoring algorithm to better account for marginal cost changes and adjusted the weighting of cost optimization vs risk factors.

entries.title: AIEI receipt validation
entries.description: Fixed JSON schema validation for AIEI receipts that was rejecting valid custom metadata fields.

entries.title: Idempotency key support
entries.description: All POST endpoints now support Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate processing on network retries.

entries.title: Legacy v1/decisions endpoint
entries.description: The v1/decisions endpoint is deprecated in favor of v1/decisions/sync and v1/decisions/async. Legacy support will be removed in version 4.0.

entries.title: Close Pack processing optimization
entries.description: Improved Close Pack batch processing speed by 40% through optimized database queries and parallel processing of independent reconciliations.

entries.title: Webhook request signing
entries.description: Webhooks now include HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Finault-Signature header for secure validation of event authenticity.

entries.title: Intelligence Report date range boundaries
entries.description: Fixed off-by-one error in Intelligence Report generation that was excluding events on the end date.

entries.title: Finault Score percentile calculation
entries.description: Adjusted percentile bucket sizes for Finault Score to provide more granular scoring distribution across customer cohorts.

entries.title: Batch decision limits increased
entries.description: Increased maximum batch size for v1/decisions/batch from 100 to 500 decisions per request.

entries.title: Close Pack v2 API
entries.description: Released new Close Pack API with support for partial reconciliations, incremental updates, and idempotent operations.

entries.title: AIEI receipt timestamp precision
entries.description: Fixed millisecond truncation in AIEI receipt timestamps that was causing timestamp mismatches in high-volume scenarios.

entries.title: EU AI Act compliance reporting
entries.description: Enhanced compliance reporting to include decision rationale and audit trail for EU AI Act transparency requirements.

entries.title: Webhook event filtering
entries.description: Added ability to configure which event types trigger webhook calls, reducing unnecessary traffic and improving system efficiency.

entries.title: Intelligence Report memory leak
entries.description: Fixed memory leak in Intelligence Report generation for reports spanning more than 30 days of data.

entries.title: Finault Score ranking algorithm
entries.description: Introduced normalized comparative scoring to better account for differences in customer scale and transaction patterns.

entries.title: Rate limiting transparency
entries.description: Added X-RateLimit-* headers to all API responses showing remaining quota and reset time.

entries.title: Legacy webhook format
entries.description: Legacy webhook format (v1) is deprecated. Migrate to v2 format before June 2026.

entries.title: AIEI receipt caching issue
entries.description: Fixed caching behavior that could return stale AIEI receipts for concurrent requests within the same second.

entries.title: Close Pack reconciliation timeout
entries.description: Increased timeout for Close Pack reconciliation from 30s to 60s to accommodate larger batches.

entries.title: Intelligence Reports GA
entries.description: General availability of Intelligence Reports feature for all enterprise customers. Includes automated report generation, custom metrics, and scheduled delivery.

entries.title: API response encoding
entries.description: Fixed UTF-8 encoding issue in API responses that could truncate special characters in metadata fields.

entries.title: Webhook retry exponential backoff
entries.description: Implemented exponential backoff for failed webhook deliveries with configurable retry policy.

entries.title: Finault Score baseline update
entries.description: Updated baseline metrics for Finault Score calculation based on Q4 2025 customer cohort data.

entries.title: Close Pack null value handling
entries.description: Fixed handling of null values in Close Pack reconciliation that could cause validation errors.

entries.title: Compliance audit logging
entries.description: Added comprehensive audit logging for all compliance-related API calls including decision rationale and regulatory references.

entries.title: AIEI receipt schema validation
entries.description: Fixed JSON schema validation to properly handle nested objects in AIEI receipt metadata.

entries.title: Deprecated v1/health/legacy endpoint
entries.description: Removed v1/health/legacy endpoint. Use v1/health instead.

entries.title: Intelligence Report performance
entries.description: Optimized Intelligence Report query performance for accounts with >1M decisions by introducing time-range indexing.

entries.title: Webhook delivery ordering
entries.description: Fixed race condition that could cause webhook events to be delivered out of order during high concurrency.

entries.title: Finault Score release
entries.description: Launched new Finault Score metric providing normalized profitability ranking across customer cohorts with daily updates.
